mapper.select: select PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.CDATE cdate, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.FINPROD_ID finprodId, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.CCY ccy, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.SHARE_AMT shareAmt, nvl(PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.MARKET_VALUE,0)+nvl(PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.TDY_INTINCEXP,0)-nvl(T5.dscCostAmt,0) dscCostAmt, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.DSC_CLEAN_PRICE dscCleanPrice, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.BUY_COST_AMT buyCostAmt, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.BUY_CLEAN_PRICE buyCleanPrice, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.MARKET_VALUE,0 marketValue, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.MARKET_CLEAN_PRICE marketCleanPrice, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.TDY_INTINCEXP,0 tdyIntincexp, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.TDY_DSCINCEXP_ADD tdy_dscincexpAdd, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.TDY_INTINCEXP_ADD tdyIntincexpAdd, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.TDY_DSCLOSS_ADD tdy_dsclossAdd, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL_ADD tdyFloatIngplAdd, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.TDY_FEE_ADD tdyFeeAdd, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.ACCU_NET_VALUE accuNetValue, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.SUB_CODE subCode, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.ZGPLAN_ID zgplanId, decode(T2.Type_8,'${fzq}',T1.ISSUER,'${fck}',T1.ISSUER,'${fxml}',T1.FINANCIER, '${gp}',T1.ISSUER,T1.MANAGER) organId, decode(T2.Type_8,'${gp}',T2.TYPE_8,'${zqjz}',T2.TYPE_8,'${whjq}' ,T2.TYPE_8,'${whyq}',T2.TYPE_8,'${whdq}',T2.TYPE_8,T2.TYPE_6) varietyType1, T2.TYPE_7 varietyType2, T2.TYPE_8 assetType from PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION LEFT JOIN ( select SUM(nvl(DSC_COST_AMT,0)+nvl(TDY_FLOAT_INGPL,0)+nvl(TDY_INTINCEXP,0)+ nvl(DELAY_PAY_AMT,0)) dscCostAmt, CDATE,PORTFOLIO_ID,FINPROD_ID from PTL_SEC_VALUTION GROUP BY CDATE,PORTFOLIO_ID,FINPROD_ID ) T5 ON T5.FINPROD_ID = PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.FINPROD_ID AND T5.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.PORTFOLIO_ID AND T5.CDATE = PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.CDATE LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T1 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID where PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.CDATE = to_date(#{currentDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')

SELECT SEQNO seqno, CREDIT_INFO_TYPE creditInfoType, CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_CODE creditQuoteTypeCode, CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE creditQuoteTypeValue, CREDIT_QUOTE_RANK creditQuoteRank FROM CREDIT_MST_INFO where CREDIT_INFO_TYPE = '04'
